map.一阶 RC 低通/高通滤波器的 -3dB 截止频率 f_c = 1/(2πRC): The -3dB cutoff frequency fc = 1/(2pi R C) and time constant tau = R C of a first-order RC low-pass/high-pass filter.
map.一阶 RC 低通/高通滤波器的 −3dB 转折频率。: The -3dB corner frequency of a first-order RC low-pass/high-pass filter.
map.1 kΩ、1 µF 对应约 159 Hz。: 1 kOhm and 1 uF correspond to about 159 Hz.
map.电阻 R 与电容 C 求 −3dB 截止 fc = 1/(2πRC)。: From resistor R and capacitor C, find the -3dB cutoff fc = 1/(2pi R C).
map.对比不同 R、C 的转折频率。: Compare corner frequencies for different R and C.
map.若 C=0.1µF，则 fc≈1591.5Hz，电容变小截止频率上移十倍。: If C=0.1uF, then fc~1591.5Hz; a smaller capacitor shifts the cutoff up by ten times.
map.截止频率是增益为 0 吗？: Is the cutoff frequency where gain is zero?
map.不是，是 −3dB（幅度降为 1/√2、功率降一半）处，即半功率点。: No, it is the -3dB point (amplitude drops to 1/sqrt(2), power drops by half), i.e. the half-power point.
map.R、C 谁对 fc 影响大？: Which affects fc more, R or C?
map.fc 与 R、C 均成反比，任一减半 fc 翻倍。: fc is inversely proportional to both R and C; halving either doubles fc.
